artifacts.summary: 8-phase, 14-hour plan for requirement (S): Cons on a finite labelled presentation, modelOf via ofSlicedStep on W := Q, presented_modelOf through the landed uniqueness lemma, and the Hit-level equality at a seam, scoped to box/stab-free phi; the carried frame-constructor prerequisite is descoped to a successor with its machine-checked core wired as evidence.

memory_candidates.content: A plan that descopes a carried prerequisite should preserve the research dispatch's machine-checked core of that prerequisite as a wired evidence artifact rather than discarding it with the phase. In the BimodalLogic ray-product batch the descoped frame-constructor's hard lemma (fib_finite_of_finBranch) and, more valuably, two refutations found while testing the carried repair shape would otherwise have survived only as report prose. Wiring the probe costs one short phase, is independent of every other phase (wave 1), and converts a report paragraph into a rot-protected green artifact the successor record can build on.
